facts.raw_span: A 50-year-old man
known neurofibromatosis type 1
multiple cutaneous neurofibromas
no history of smoking
recurrent urinary retention and sepsis
transurethral resection of the prostate revealed fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia
diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall without a discrete mass
bladder wall was diffusely thickened, firm, and gray–white, with near–complete loss of the detrusor muscle
diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation with comma-shaped nuclei and a collagenous matrix
dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern
tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
tumor cells were negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, MDM2, p63, ALK, CD117, DOG1, myogenin, desmin, and smooth muscle actin
